description: PS5-style launcher for the AnyPS5 engine: finds game dumps, unlocks them and starts them, with controls, saves and trophies per game
notes: The launcher downloads the AnyPS5 engine (relinker and system libraries) from upstream releases into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AnyPS5\Toolkits` the first time it unlocks a game, so it does not need the `anyps5` package.
It detects a Scoop install and asks for `scoop update anyps5-desktop` instead of running the installer itself.
